APEX GRIP

OVERCHARGE increases CONTROL and ACCELERATION beyond their ordinary limits.

epicINSTALLABLE
Original car
Race Car
Unlock
1,100 trophies · Race Car

Use it

Prepare OVERCHARGE before the section where you want extra control and acceleration.

Make it work together

The benefit depends on OVERCHARGE being present. TORQUE on Race Car can complement its original APEX GRIP.

Try it on

Truck

An illustrative pairing once the car, perk and PERKULATOR are unlocked. Compare it with the same car’s original setup.

Installing

Unlock its source car and the perk, then choose it in PERKULATOR. No cloning or collecting copies is needed. It uses the one INSTALLED slot and cannot duplicate the destination car’s own perk.
